name: Wildwalker pets get Spirit Beast Master's extra talent points, also after a UI reload (#5390)
contract: ChrSpecs.dbc lists Spirit Beast Master 300716 as the Wildwalker spec (59) passive. Its second effect is
SPELL_AURA_MOD_PET_TALENT_POINTS with base points 5 (+6). Nothing taught it, so a level 60 pet had only the
native (60 - 16) / 4 = 11 points instead of 17. Expected: a level 60 Wildwalker knows 300716 and wears its
aura, and a level 60 tamed beast has 11 + 6 = 17 free pet talent points.
A UI reload clears the client's pet talent points; the client asks again with CMSG_REQUEST_PET_INFO, which
only rebuilt the pet action bar, so the talent frame showed 0 until the pet was resummoned. Expected: that
request also sends SMSG_TALENTS_INFO for the pet.

steps.label: SETUP: Spirit Beast Master is known
The Wildwalker spec teaches the pet talent passive
A level 60 pet has 11 native plus 6 extra talent points
The client reloads its UI and asks for its pet's data
The pet's talent points are sent again
